key_insight: ShapeR reconstructs complete, high-quality 3D object shapes from casual, real-world image sequences by fusing sparse SLAM geometry, 3D detections, and vision-language semantic cues—removing the need for clean, segmented inputs.
problem_solved: Overcomes the reliance of prior 3D generation methods on clean, unoccluded, well-segmented captures by enabling robust conditional shape generation from noisy, occluded, and casually captured sequences.
method: Extract per-object sparse geometric priors using off-the-shelf visual-inertial SLAM and 3D detection on casual image sequences.
Leverage vision-language models to provide semantic and category-conditioned cues for each detected object.
Fuse sparse SLAM points, detections, and language priors in a generative model that completes and refines full 3D shapes robust to occlusion and imperfect segmentation.
impact: Enables practitioners to generate reliable 3D object models from real-world, unconstrained captures—reducing the need for controlled scans and accelerating applications in AR, robotics, and dataset creation.
